meta.source: BGV Brand Kit v1.0 (bgv-tokens.json) + design system decisions
meta.note: Navy/amber theme (owner palette, 2026-10-15) mapped onto the BGV semantic roles; token names kept for code compatibility (brand-green = navy, brand-coral = amber). Seats, coin and tiers unchanged. All text pairs ≥ 4.5:1, control edges ≥ 3:1 in both themes. v1.5 (2026-10-20): dark theme «ink navy». v1.6 (2026-10-20, rounds 1–5): light theme «عاج نرم + بالشتک سفید»; neutral buttons are white pillows with a 1.5px slate edge; every selection navy; ModeTag. v1.7 (2026-10-20, QA copy): button colours, edges and shadows are tokens (no hard-coded hex in the Button block); «رد» is secondary; dock and toggle selection navy; felt-line ≥ 3:1; fonts self-hosted. v1.8 (2026-10-21, clay pass): one material per role — tile (raised, lip, presses), row (flat, tints, presses), well (inset), board, print, plate/piece; neutral tiles get a 3px #7D8B96 bottom lip instead of a stroke (owner choice); no glass or glow; opaque felt tiles and plates. v1.8.1: secondary buttons get a 1.5px navy stroke (owner request) on top of the lip. v2.0 (2026-10-21, owner choice B «توکن چاپی»): the design language leaves claymorphism. Pressables are printed game tokens — a 2px ink frame and a hard offset shadow, no blur; hover lifts 1px, press lands the token on the table; selection is a flat navy fill. Every shadow in the system is hard (no blur). v2.0.1: a selected token stays raised (navy + --ink-selected) so it stays one family with its siblings; game-bar actions are one size. v2.0.2: the dark-theme ink is a warm grey #857D71 (frame and shadow one colour) instead of the bright cream #F3EBDD. v2.1 (2026-10-22): site shell — the site header replaces the sidebar (--sidebar-w removed, --header-h 72, --topbar-h 56, --content-max 1320); new colour roles for the neutral avatar disc, the «you» table row and my chat bubble; dark labels cream #E3D3B8.

shadow.note: Printed token (v2.0): every shadow is hard, no blur. Pressables have an ink frame and an offset shadow that lands on press; cards have a 3px printed edge; floating boards a 6px hard shadow; the felt is a table with a navy base.
